infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RakshaSetu needs your location to keep you safe and alert you if you enter high-risk or restricted zones.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RakshaSetu monitors your safety in real-time during your trips and dispatches help if you trigger SOS.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RakshaSetu needs microphone access so you can speak your safety and emergency questions to Raksha AI.
